limits: No candidate edits, Git/index mutation, tag, install, selector or remote effect performed by this Writer. Owner-requested candidate freezes, checks and isolated verification-only materialization were performed; all release coordinates retain their declared fictional/actual distinctions.
No semantic qualification, independent review, owner replacement decision or acceptance is established by these mechanical gates.

Reference parsing covers documented forms; prose, unlinked code paths, generated-project routes, custom Markdown extensions, general JSON-schema conformance and frame fidelity need separate checks/review.
The trusted interpreter/standard library and separate installed verifier are explicit dependencies; the checker does not authenticate its own launcher or the external runtime.
Supplied release coordinates are checked for shape/consistency, not attested against Git objects; materialization creates no release ref.

installed_toolchain.scope: Observed development-tool identity for fixture schema/materialization tests; not authentication of the entire interpreter or toolchain dependency closure.
